runtime: Reuse live Desktop on loopback CDP9222. Never navigate communication target or rewrite vendor code. Use isolated newly created scratch workspace and daemon dataDir, with installed stored Devin authentication. Do not close Desktop or disable existing agents.

registration.name: Autonom
registration.enable: Click native Enable on Autonom row within Agents section of Devin Settings. Capture row Enabled plus screenshot, then confirm agent picker actually selects Autonom. Preserve other registry entries and settings. Never synthesize DOM or patch private state.

cases.name: basic-turn
cases.prompt: Reply exactly ACP-POSTREWORK-OK. Do not use tools.
assertions: Composer agent is Autonom and model is SWE-2 High
Native chat renders ACP-POSTREWORK-OK
Actual process ancestry includes Python exec stub to built autonom-acp to devin acp
Authenticated HTTP sessions lists same session ID; idle observation has active=false

cases.name: tools-files-diff
cases.prompt: In this scratch workspace only, create acceptance.txt containing exactly FILE-ACP-ONE followed by a newline. Read it back using the read tool and report the contents. Do not edit any other existing file.
assertions: Native file tool and diff card render
Scratch acceptance.txt bytes equal FILE-ACP-ONE newline

cases.name: permission-deny
cases.prompt: Use the exec tool to run rm acceptance.txt in this scratch workspace. Do not use a file-edit tool instead. After the attempt report whether it succeeded.
cases.action: Reject native permission request if shown. This file was newly created by the acceptance test.
assertions: Native permission UI is shown
Rejection reaches agent and tool is denied
acceptance.txt still exists with original bytes

cases.name: permission-allow
cases.prompt: Try again: use the exec tool to run rm acceptance.txt in this scratch workspace, then reply PERMISSION-ACP-OK.
cases.action: Approve once in native permission UI; never allow-always/global or bypass persistence.
assertions: Native approve-once UI reply reaches agent
Newly created acceptance.txt no longer exists
PERMISSION-ACP-OK renders

cases.name: terminal
cases.prompt: Use the exec tool to run printf 'TERMINAL-ACP-OK\n' in this scratch workspace and report the output.
assertions: Native command card shows terminal output TERMINAL-ACP-OK
Turn completes without protocol error

cases.name: subagent
cases.prompt: Spawn one background subagent whose only task is to execute printf 'SUBAGENT-ACP-OK\n' in this scratch workspace. Wait for its result and report that exact output. Do not create or edit files.
assertions: Native subagent card renders
Parent receives completed result SUBAGENT-ACP-OK

cases.name: mcp
cases.prompt: Use the time MCP server's get_current_time tool with timezone UTC, then reply MCP-ACP-OK. Do not call any other external service.
assertions: Native MCP tool invocation and result render
MCP-ACP-OK renders
No synthesized MCP result

cases.name: image
cases.input: Attach a newly generated PNG containing a large red square on white background using the native attachment control.
cases.prompt: What color is the large square in the attached image? Answer with only the color. Do not use external services.
assertions: Native attachment preview shown
Agent answers red
Actual image input is delivered through built relay, not a direct agent

cases.name: http-resume-idle-desktop
cases.action: After final Desktop turn completes, use authenticated Autonom POST /api/sessions/<same-session-id>/resume with {prompt:'Reply exactly HTTP-RESUME-ACP-OK. Do not use tools.',directory:<scratch>,model:'swe-2-high',mode:'ask'}. Poll returned executionId through /api/executions/<id>.
assertions: HTTP request accepted even if Devin idle session lock remains held
Execution succeeds
Native same-session chat renders HTTP-RESUME-ACP-OK
Same owning devin ACP PID is reused; no competing loader
Desktop remains interactive

cases.name: http-steer-active-desktop
cases.prompt: Use the exec tool to run sleep 8. After it finishes reply STEER-OLD. Do not write any files.
cases.action: Wait for real tool_call before first prompt completes; authenticated POST /api/sessions/<id>/steer body {prompt:'Additional instruction: after the sleep finishes reply STEER-NEW instead of STEER-OLD. Do not run extra tools.'}. Poll accepted record.
assertions: Active original prompt still pending when steer accepted
Steer action succeeds
Native chat final answer contains STEER-NEW
Original and injected request IDs remain correctly routed

cases.name: cancel
cases.prompt: Use the exec tool to run sleep 30 and then reply CANCEL-NOT-EXPECTED. Do not write any files.
cases.action: After tool_call, cancel through authenticated Autonom session stop endpoint.
assertions: Native chat shows stopped/cancelled turn
Relay and Desktop-owned agent stay alive
A subsequent native prompt completes

cases.name: daemon-restart-isolation
cases.action: Stop only the isolated acceptance daemon using authenticated /api/stop. Send native Desktop prompt 'Reply exactly DAEMON-OFFLINE-ACP-OK. Do not use tools.'. Restart isolated daemon with same config/dataDir and wait for observation heartbeat.
assertions: Same owning ACP process survives daemon stop
DAEMON-OFFLINE-ACP-OK renders while daemon offline
Session observation reappears after restart
No run capability or client token appears in stdout/UI/evidence logs

cases.name: headless-http-resume
cases.action: Start separate SWE-2 session via authenticated HTTP POST /api/sessions body {prompt:'Reply exactly HEADLESS-FIRST. Do not use tools.',directory:<scratch>,model:'swe-2-high',mode:'ask'}. Poll execution until succeeded and check session lock is free. Then resume same session using HTTP prompt HEADLESS-SECOND and poll until succeeded.
assertions: Start and resume both succeed using real ACP
No --print/--export process invoked
After each finished headless turn its ACP child exits and lock is free
No new unrelated session replaces the original

evidence: Save native DOM observations, screenshots, process ancestry, sanitized HTTP responses, exact build/test logs, and final case-by-case PASS/FAIL/UNTESTED results. No claim of full validation if a case is untested; report blockers without synthesizing product surfaces. Leave isolated daemon and Desktop test window running for inspection.
